Positive by construction, so a bare Gaussian can generate impossible draws. Shares gravimetry_coupon with the hydrated volume and the dry mass: one balance, one segmentation.
Correlated with the density it denominates and with the segmentation that produced it. Sampling it independently would break rho_wet = m/V.

COMPOSITIONAL DATA. Fractions must stay non-negative and sum to 1, so independent Gaussian perturbation is invalid. Oxygen-by-difference creates strong negative correlations that must survive into the transport ensemble.

A FIELD uncertainty, not a scalar. Alternative plausible masks move biovolume, surface geometry, the selected pitch, CSG placement and per-label dose at once, so the propagation object is a set of fields sharing specimen identifiers.
Bootstrap across independent stacks and pitch-selection outcomes, jointly with the segmentation and occupancy decisions that produced it.

BOUNDED in [0,1]. Melanin radioprotection is not a universal monotonic coefficient — it varies with chemical composition, spatial arrangement, metabolic state and radiation modality — so this is a distribution over a scenario, never a fixed multiplier.
Joint with oxidation state and speciation. The radiodialysis path is blocked by a units error upstream, so measuring this does not unblock it; it is available to the offline MATERIAL screen only.
CANCELS from a relative effect, so the offline material screen runs per source particle before any certificate exists. Absolute Gy/s and any time-integrated dose get no such cancellation.
Once Reference D moves past an idealized line source, placement uncertainty moves the whole field.
Fixed evaluated data plus explicit library scenarios. Emission probabilities carry uncertainty only where a defensible evaluation supplies it.

DO NOT INVENT A GAUSSIAN CROSS-SECTION UNCERTAINTY. No usable photo-atomic covariance package was identified. Keep the pinned library for reproducibility, check attenuation against an independent calculation, and treat a library change as a named sensitivity scenario.

NOT a physical parameter: it estimates Var_xi(dQ|theta). Mesh bins are not independent — one history scores several — so per-label uncertainty comes from independent replicate RUNS, never from summing per-bin variances.

Sized against uncertainty in dQ, not against a generic per-voxel criterion: A0's aggregate seed spread was ~0.013% while its median bin error was 6.7%, so an aggregate QoI converges far faster than a bin-level field.

NOT AN ALEATORY VARIABLE. A0 showed the statistical error falls with histories while resolution loss does not: factor 2 already discards 17.7% of the field structure. Carry a residual discretization BOUND from the biofilm sweep instead of sampling factors.
The exact CSG denominator is a raytracing ESTIMATE with its own O(1/sqrt n) error. It gets its own budget line because the mass is the denominator of every dose.

Production must use exact_csg_raytrace. The full-bin method overstates A0's cylinder by exactly 4/pi because it weighs the circumscribing cube — a known NEGATIVE CONTROL, not an equally weighted ensemble member.
Frozen as threshold at tau=0.5. A categorical modelling choice gets a named branch, never an invented categorical probability.
Online gate only. A survival curve is not evidence for a directional term; the one directional dataset measures hyphal elongation, which a parcel CPM cannot represent.

STRUCTURALLY UNIDENTIFIABLE ALONE: only the PRODUCT of production and coupling reaches the dynamics. Fix one coefficient independently or reparameterize around the identifiable product; no quantity of data separates them otherwise.
Shares melanin_product with the row above. Hard-coded at 0.5 at its call site and dominating the tropism by four orders of magnitude over beta_ion.
Required for any time-integrated online dose. Downstream of the pitch AND the selected temporal observable.
The CPM has no birth and no death, so radiotrophy as enhanced growth and radioresistance as survival are structurally absent. A model-revision problem, not a missing-data one.
The m-versus-P_eff constitutive contradiction is unresolved. Fixed-membrane one-way dosimetry does not need it; any dose-responsive feedback does.
